## How to use this file

- Choose the language first with [language-selection-checklist](../assets/language-selection-checklist.md).
- Then open the matching SDK repository and verify the installed version's README, tags, examples, or release notes before copying APIs.
- Use [latest docs](./latest-docs.md) first when you need the current doc index or a reminder of which official page covers which feature.
